statements.text: `GET /tasks/count` returns HTTP 200 with a JSON object `{ "count": <integer> }`, where `count` is the total number of tasks currently in the store.
`count` always equals the number of items returned by `GET /tasks` for the same store at the same moment.
Creating a task (`POST /tasks`, 201) increases `count` by exactly 1.
Deleting a task (`DELETE /tasks/{id}`, 204) decreases `count` by exactly 1.
The root health endpoint `GET /` and all existing `/tasks` CRUD behaviour are unchanged: the 5 baseline tests still pass and `dotnet build` stays green.
